variables.name: nmot_w

variables.name: InjSys_ratEthPrtnBascFu

variables.name: rl_w

variables.name: tmot
variables.diagnosis: (-35.99 + 48) / 0.7498 ≈ 16 = raw byte value. Decoded as `raw=16` would give -35.99°C. Plausibility: ambient 20°C requires raw≈90. The raw=16 reading either means the wrong address is being read (something near-zero), OR signedness is flipped (byte 0xF0 interpreted as 16 instead of 240, which would give 132°C — too hot).

variables.name: wdkba
variables.diagnosis: raw=1 * scale = 0.39%. Either the throttle is reading raw=1 (very close to 0 but off by 1), OR a different variable's byte position is being read here. Lowest-priority discrepancy of the 6.
